The mass of one mole of a substance, expressed in grams per mole, numerically equivalent to the atomic or molecular mass in amu.

A unit of mass equal to one twelfth the mass of a carbon-12 atom, used to express atomic and molecular masses.
The number of constituent particles contained in one mole of a substance, precisely $$6.022 \times 10^{23}$$.
